notes.title: Special Christmas event!
notes.content:
[h1]Ciao, famiglia![/h1]

[b]The Christmas[/b] is just around the corner, and I just wanted to take a sec and say, we've got a pretty awesome crew here. We've had each other's backs through thick and thin, and that's something to celebrate.

But in the spirit of the season, let's not overlook the significance of our relationships beyond these walls – our real [b]families[/b], the ones who we care about and stand for no matter what. We are proposing you to bring your close ones into our beautiful restaurant for a feast! [b]Expect special guests, too![/b]

[h1]🎄Christmas event is here!🎄[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/0527bb9d5bf5bcdf8444b13e861e1abcdd96efa1.png[/img]

[h2]🎄 Decorate your restaurant![/h2]
Gather Christmas-themed decorations

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/62840038cfd376f51460b843efdcf16f671f79f9.gif[/img]

[h2]🎩 New costumes![/h2]
Your goons now wear special outfits to support the mood

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/7d233090b59129e26205b0ea219533d5a63b32a6.gif[/img]

[h2]❄️ Put the guns away![/h2]
Gang's leaders came to an agreement and agreed to use snowballs instead of bullets to fight for turf!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/63d92dc6363e2dca9e1b57e605e494ae118d71bc.gif[/img]

[h2]🎅 Roll the Christmas party![/h2]
Invite Santa Claus and serve him the best dish you have

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/cff9d86c847bfd6f9b5c0fbd27344606fe38b706.gif[/img]

[h2]🌆 We're on Steam Winter Sale![/h2]
And to top it off - we've hopped on Steam Winter Sale with a 30% discount, so you have a chance to celebrate with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/5767e96a8a81af71d5d867f3ead394068a55141e.png[/img]

---

As the year wraps up, we want to express our heartfelt thanks for your incredible support in Don Duality. Your passion and dedication have made this journey unforgettable. Here's to more adventures together in the coming year!

[h3]Thank you for playing![/h3]

[b]Don Duality[/b] is a thrilling tycoon game that challenges players to manage a dual life of crime and entrepreneurship. Build a criminal empire by sending your gangsters to collect debts, rob banks, and steal valuables. Use the money earned to launder it in your legitimate business establishment. notes.title: New level of gameplay! | HUGE update
notes.content:
[h2]Ciao tutti![/h2]

We have released a [b]big update[/b] that will elevate your gameplay to a whole [b]new level[/b]! Adding [b]character progression[/b] with skill trees, special abilities, new cards and many QOL changes.

[h3][b]Let's dive in![/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=zlyzp7QFC9c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Level Up![/h1]

First of all - let's talk about our main dish - [u][b]Character Progression[/b][/u]. This is a completely new mechanic, that will let your goons, waiters and cooks gain experience, and gain perks with each new level. You can combine several perks, or go further and unlock special abilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/44c79a39cb79135ed8573a7db9dae4b90d8eba52.gif[/img]

Your workers will gain XP every time they do their job. Cooks will get XP for making food, waiters for serving the clients, and goons for completing missions and winning battles against rival gangs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/7f32e18e03cdd33a8b900c82fb6e427e7aa5d55d.gif[/img]

Then, after one of your characters gain enough XP, a level-up card will get shuffled into your deck. Once you will use it - you'll see a skill tree and will be able to choose one of the options. There are quite juicy skills that you can pick, so keep these goons safe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/c98ca73ee2ae574010b112fa2677e680a25a1259.gif[/img]

[h3]And there's more![/h3]

Here is the list of other changes and fixes present in this update

[b]Character progression:[/b]
- Added skill trees to employees.
- Added the ability to unlock new skills when leveling up.
- Added 12 new skills for employees.

[b]Misc:[/b]
- New patron skins.
- All dishes in the menu now divided into tiers.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
- Fixed police attention gauge.
- Fixed repeated upgrade cards draw.
- Fixed VIP cards bugging after winning a fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/136c4bef71172d948feea7e1042e184dd97eb782.gif[/img]

[h2]Tell us your feedback![/h2]

We are really excited to hear your feedback on this update! We worked hard to implement this new mechanic, and we are thrilled to hear your feedback in the Discussions. Thank you for staying with us and keep your eyes on the news!

[h3]See you in our beautiful restaurant![/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.8 | Better Call Antonio
notes.content:
[b]Buongiorno, Famiglia![/b]

We have just released a new update, featuring some long-awaited changes to the gameplay. Let's dive in!

Here are three biggest changes to the gameplay:

[b][h3]"I give up!" button.[/h3][/b]This button will finally let you quickly end the run and extract some money, skipping through the boring court. If you ended up in a tough situation - this button will definitely come in handy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/88562709cbd453915e1215ce7b5464b806f8296a.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Changed districts reward.[/h3][/b]From now on, all captured districts will generate daily income in black or white cash. This will help you quickly get on your feet when starting a new run in the late game. As always, central districts are the most profitable ones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/562f0c1456bde418e0334d9a971fcc5ff46a9d03.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Antonio sends help.[/h3][/b]Many of our players said that they had a problem when all of their gangsters have died and made the game unplayable, as they couldn't afford to hire new gangsters. They asked: "What should i do?"

Better Call Antonio! Now, if you have no gangsters and no black cash - your fellow friend Antonio Buonelli will send you one common gangster. This will hopefully solve the issue with being stuck with no gangsters, and even if not - you also have a "I give up!" card!

[b][h3]A little sneak-peak into the future.[/h3][/b]Hola amigos! We saw the demand for the Spanish localization of the game. and we are happy to announce that we are actively working on adding it into the game! We expect to finish it really soon, so stay tuned!

As always, [b]thank you for your feedback![/b] Without it, it wouldn't be possible to release all these new updates!

Please, share your thoughts on the update in our Discussions! We read it all!
See you in the next updates!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.6 | LOTS of changes!
notes.content:
[h3]Buongiorno, famiglia![/h3]

It's been a while since our last update, but rest assured, we've been hard at work! We've made significant changes to the gameplay, introduced quality-of-life features, and we're closing in on completing our September Fixes list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/c0844420a035b998b7e5e0471b1edfee3abc75eb.png[/img]

But first of all, [b]THANK YOU FOR YOUR FEEDBACK[/b]! 

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to all our players for the invaluable feedback you've shared about the game. Your input is instrumental in our ongoing efforts to enhance the gaming experience. Thank you for being an essential part of our community!

Please, share your opinion on this update. It is critical for us to hear your feedback and improve the game even further.

[h2][b]Let's dive into the major changes![/b][/h2]

[b][h3]Economy changes[/h3][/b]
We've revamped the in-game economy to address the previous imbalance where players had great amounts of clean cash but struggled with black cash deficits, often leading to crippling debt in pre-IOU rework builds.

The tables have turned: now all salaries and upgrades are paid in clean cash, making it less available in the early game, while black cash is now primarily for laundering, as it should be. Some cards will still consume black cash, but you won't run out of it if you stay relatively active on the streets.

Of course, we can't show you all the balance changes in one GIF, you'll have to feel them in the game yourself.

We will keep on refining the game's balance, but we will need your opinion on these changes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/18ab577509eb3f811c350c2e7f51311cc9421632.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Bell indicator[/h3][/b]
We've introduced a special indicator above the deck, signaling when the next card you draw will feature a bell, eliminating the need to rely solely on luck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/0daabd955f35bc992895aba404721fc936ba2665.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Boredom meter[/h3][/b]
Addressing concerns about gangster behavior, we've added a visual indicator that shows when a gangster is getting bored, helping you better manage their actions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/22552176d5732cddfc09742bf809228856bc137f.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Manual Battle Card activation[/h3][/b]
This feature was already integrated into the previous version. Now, you can click on a battle card to initiate combat instantly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/4c1c87864ee6c4daac232009fc8478734bf27f52.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Client's Order Bubbles[/h3][/b]
You can now see what your clients want to order as they approach their table, giving you clearer insight into the impact of your upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/650504dc49e9771ed23958aab80123690d73b822.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Tutorial Update[/h3][/b]
We've revamped the tutorial to provide new players with a better understanding of how event cards are activated and how the debt card functions. Try it out yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/62db21a86b963c36555440ffc9a14d5a16d67ac3.gif[/img]

[b][h3]"Game Pause" Checkbox[/h3][/b]
We've included a new checkbox in the game settings called "App Pause." When disabled, the game won't pause when you switch to another window.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/d55d386715297150e803c47b3dbe4a104a5b1bb6.gif[/img]

This is a [b]big [/b] update and we are in dire need of feedback. Tell us what you think about it, because we won't stop refining the game until it is perfect. We do care about the game, and we care about your opinion on it.

See you in the future updates!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.9 | IOU Rework
notes.content:
[h3]Buongiorno![/h3]

We've been busy the last two days, and now we released 1.0.1.9 update, featuring a reworked IOU card and QOL changes. We received many complaints about this card, so we decided to change it so it wouldn't be as destructive as it was.

But first, a little announcement:

[b]We've released the game's official soundtrack![/b] If you enjoy the music - you can get it for only $2.99!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566660/Don_Duality_Soundtrack/

[h2]The IOU card rework[/h2]

In the previous version, it was probably the most frightening thing that could happen to you. It generated an unlimited amount of bells, it raised police attention, and you could only pay it once you’ve accumulated [i]ALL [/i]the necessary money. Horrible fate for anyone who's accumulated a few thousand in their IOU cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/90144ffd4b73117531b4820e119d8cc4883add05.gif[/img]

[b]But now it's different. [/b]

[h3]IOU card changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Removed infinite bells
[*] Removed generation of police attention
[*] Now the IOU card will take 50% of the respective income money and will reduce the debt by the taken amount.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/a155d9d9f659062c7665e04400f7bd7e80ed230f.gif[/img]

[h3]We've also made some minor changes, here's the list:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Hints fixes
[*] Battle card can now be played to instantly initiate combat
[*] Minor bugfixes
[*] Balance fixes
[/list]

That is not the end and we will keep updating the game. Please, share your feedback on the update, We read everything you send us.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.5 | Save System
notes.content:
[b]Ciao, famiglia![/b]

You asked for it - and we did it. The game now has a [b]SAVE SYSTEM[/b]! You don't have to worry about the game progression when you need to go grab some pizza, because now you can return back to the game whenever you want! 

We read all, and i mean [i]ALL[/i] your feedback in the Steam Hub discussions and the reviews, and we work tirelessly to make the game better and comfortable for everyone. 

Here's a little presentation on how it works:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/2ee54e5f5c6acc906fe56fb0abf8e43d38725b50.gif[/img]

[list]
[b][*] Save system was implemented in the current build, which allows saving progress mid-run and loading it later.
[*] Increased the cost of a Romantic Concert boost card.
[*] Increased the reward gained from risky missions.
[*] Increased the chances of triggering the character's traits.
[*] Fixed repeating crashes, the game is now more stable.
[*] Coffee machine 2 was fixed, it is now works as intended.
[*] City map was fixed, now it should work smoothly, without any problems of selecting districts.
[*] UI fixes and changes
[*] Minor bugfixes[/b]
[/list]
These are significant changes and we hope that you'll like them! Please, share your feedback or thoughts on the game, we read it all.

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.11 | Tutorial Fix
notes.content:
Ciao, famiglia!

It was a sleepless night for us, we made [b]11 new build updates[/b], fixing bugs and occurring issues that you sent us in the Discussions.

notes.title: The Grand Opening! | Don Duality is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Ciao, Famiglia! [/b]

The time has come. The moment that we've all been waiting for! Waiters are ready, cooks are sharpening their knives, and gangsters are loading their guns! 

[b]Don Duality[/b] has finally been released, with a list of upcoming updates!

[previewyoutube=3HWlJrafHnc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]GRAB YOUR COPY WITH A 15% DISCOUNT![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2247570/Don_Duality/

Now, here's a quick introduction to what you'll experience in [b]Don Duality.[/b]

[h3][b]Your Own Restaurant[/b][/h3]

Your restaurant will expand and improve. Buy extra tables to seat everyone who wants to visit your establishment. Advertise to increase popularity and invite as many people to your place as possible. But remember, the more people your restaurant attracts, the more staff will have to be hired to serve them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/d80d2a6954e16e3a56b8da3916010bedca0a301b.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Lead A Mafia Organization[/b][/h3]

Most of your subordinates will be Gangsters. Send them on a variety of criminal activities. Rob banks, beat money out of debtors, intimidate cops and take control over the city streets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/136c4bef71172d948feea7e1042e184dd97eb782.gif[/img]

[h3][b]A City To Be Conquered[/b][/h3]

With the death of your father, criminal gangs have seized control over the city's districts. It's time to fight them back! Send gangsters to fight the enemy, build your own team, and meet the bosses of hostile organizations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/a3ef7304c6748243545b4232b7074e5014444589.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Lots of Collectables[/b][/h3]

Buy Gold Cards to have powerful instruments for your business, and collect Rare Scenes that will tell you little stories about life in the Don Duality family!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/f5f90d2d3ae3671ff85893579b16980b864af0ca.gif[/img]

The journey of releasing [b]Don Duality[/b] is a whirlwind of emotions, from the exhilarating anticipation before launch to the nervous excitement on release day. The highs come with positive reviews and fan appreciation on Demo and Prologue, while the lows arrive in the form of bugs and critical feedback. But through it all, the resilience gained and lessons learned to shape us as developers. It's a rollercoaster ride of happiness, a testament to the [b]passion [/b]and [b]dedication [/b]poured into every pixel and line of code.

[h3][b]Future Updates[/b][/h3]

But that's not the end! Don Duality will expand with new features. Take a look at this roadmap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/994df18150063ed5739b94a4658cfa5e2bbca501.png[/img]

[h3][b]Additional Content[/b][/h3]

We've released the game's official soundtrack! If you enjoy the music - you can get it for only $2.99!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566660/Don_Duality_Soundtrack

We also wrote a guide into the game with several helpful advices and a strategy that we like to call: "How to eliminate your first mob gang for dummies"!

notes.content:

Signore e signori!
This is Mike, your faithful consigliere and I come to you with good news!
[b]Don Duality[/b], the tycoon game with card mechanics, is looking for beta testers.

Well, well, well, look who we have here. It's your loyal consigliere, Mike. I come bearing good news, eh? [b]Don Duality[/b], the tycoon game with card mechanics, is on the hunt for beta testers. You know what that means, don't you? It's time to make our mark and show the world what we're made of. We need our best men on this one, so round up the crew and let's get this job done.

We've been hard at work since the demo, and we're excited to announce some major updates to Don Duality! In addition to refining the gameplay mechanics and balancing the difficulty, we've added new features like expanded customization options for your gangsters and restaurant staff. We've also incorporated player feedback to improve the user interface and overall user experience. With these updates, we're confident that Don Duality will provide even more engaging gameplay and immersive storytelling than before. 

Step into the shoes of a Don, manage your empire and navigate the delicate balance between running a successful restaurant and operating a thriving mafia.

[b]How to participate in the Closed Beta Testing?[/b]
[list]
[*] Kindly leave a comment beneath this announcement indicating your intent to participate in the closed beta testing.
[*] Please extend a friend request to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/bearplaster]me[/url] and initiate conversation with the following message: "Greetings, I am participating in the closed beta for Don Duality."
[*] Upon accepting your friend request, you will receive a unique Steam key granting access to the Closed Beta.
